string.name: format_color_help
string.description: Helper text for the custom color XML image format example in the Fresco Showcase app. Keep the following technical terms in English and do not translate them: "Fresco" is the name of the Meta Android image loading library, and "Drawable" is the name of an Android framework class (as in the Fresco DrawableFactory API).

resources.string: This example adds a custom color XML image format (<color>#rrggbb</color>), decoder, and Drawable factory. In this example, you have to enable the decoder globally when Fresco is initialized. Toggle the switch and restart the application to enable/disable custom color XML support.

This example adds a custom SVG image format, decoder, and Drawable factory that has to be enabled when Fresco is initialized. Toggle the switch and restart the application to enable/disable SVG support.
Keyframes animations are only supported on devices running Android 4.0.3 (API level 15) and above.

This example overrides the decoder to be used for the given image. You can use this approach if you do not want to set a global custom decoder. The image will be decoded correctly even if global color decoding is disabled.

string.name: format_name_jpeg_landscape
string.description: Dropdown option in the Fresco Showcase resizing demo. Selecting it loads a sample JPEG image in landscape orientation. Here "landscape" refers to the image orientation (wider than tall), not to a landscape/scenery photograph.

string.name: format_name_jpeg_portrait
string.description: Dropdown option in the Fresco Showcase resizing demo. Selecting it loads a sample JPEG image in portrait orientation. Here "portrait" refers to the image orientation (taller than wide), not to a portrait photograph of a person.

string.name: format_name_png_landscape
string.description: Dropdown option in the Fresco Showcase resizing demo. Selecting it loads a sample PNG image in landscape orientation. Here "landscape" refers to the image orientation (wider than tall), not to a landscape/scenery photograph.

string.name: format_name_png_portrait
string.description: Dropdown option in the Fresco Showcase resizing demo. Selecting it loads a sample PNG image in portrait orientation. Here "portrait" refers to the image orientation (taller than wide), not to a portrait photograph of a person.

string.name: vito_view_prefetch_title
string.description: Section heading on a Fresco Showcase demo screen, shown above a row of buttons labeled "Bitmap", "Encoded" and "Disk". It labels the group of options for choosing which image cache the sample image is prefetched into. This is a static label ending in a colon, not a button or an action the user performs, so translate it as a noun-style heading rather than as an imperative command. "cache" means the image library's in-memory or on-disk image cache.

string.name: vito_view_ktx_help
string.description: Helper text on a Fresco Showcase demo screen, shown below a sample image. "Vito View" is the name of the Android View-based image loading component of the Fresco image library, and "Kotlin Extensions" means the Kotlin extension functions it provides for loading an image into a View. The screen shows examples of using those extension functions. Keep "Vito View" and "Kotlin Extensions" untranslated: they are API names.
